theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_etp_loc_frame_projection
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → ∀ x : Euclid P, Q.starProjection x = inner ℝ x a • a + inner ℝ x e • e
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
